summary: The pinned correction validly rejects STS temperatures that overflow to float32 infinity, but it does not enforce the full positive finite runtime-temperature contract: finite positive JSON values such as 1e-50 underflow to float32 zero and are accepted. The accumulated dynamic-verification feature also remains unverified with a real DFlash2 checkpoint/pair and live serving workload.

tests.command: Detached checkout a6054529682765cc1846bc6239d283363162f3ad; PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python pinned-python inline DFlashWorkerV2 STS load with [1e308, 2.0] and finite-runtime assertion
tests.what_was_measured: The candidate parent accepted the finite JSON value, stored tensor([inf, 2.]), and produced confidence 0.5 for a positive logit at the overflowed position.
The exact candidate rejects float32 overflow and preserves the prior confidence-head calibration state.

tests.command: Exact-candidate inline boundary probe for float32 maximum, overflow, underflow, and ordinary positive STS values
tests.what_was_measured: Overflowing 3.4028236e38 and 1e308 were rejected, but positive 1e-50 underflowed to float32 zero and was accepted and installed.
76 tests and 18 subtests passed across DFlash confidence/logits and shared scheduler/STS behavior.
One ROCm GPU test and 22 parameterized subtests passed against independent PyTorch references for shared scheduling and verification kernels.

gpu_execution.evidence: Shared kernel parity ran on one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) with ROCm/HIP 7.2 and passed 22 independent numerical-reference subtests. No real DFlash2 model execution was possible.

remaining_counterexamples: A finite positive STS JSON temperature such as 1e-50 passes shared validation, underflows to float32 zero in DFlashWorkerV2, passes the candidate's isfinite-only check, and is installed despite the strictly-positive runtime temperature contract.

No real compatible DFlash2 checkpoint with a trained survival head was loaded, so enable_confidence_head/confidence_head naming, tensor shapes, bias, dtype, and optional Markov schema remain unverified.
No real compatible DFlash2 target/draft pair was available to verify lossless end-to-end behavior across sampling, grammar, continuous batching, overlap relay, and live compact graph replay.
The expected mixed-quality concurrent-serving throughput benefit remains unmeasured.
remaining_limitations: No compatible DFlash2 checkpoint or target/draft pair was supplied or cached.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify DFlash2-specific checkpoint compatibility, semantic correctness, graph replay, or throughput and was not used as proof.
GPU evidence covers shared kernels only, not real DFlash2 serving.
No native C/C++/CUDA/HIP/FlyDSL source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
